label: CRASH-1
title: CRASH-1 — compute tier progress percentage with TDD
description: Disposable Node fixture, first of two dependent crash-recovery cards. Add and export tierProgressPercent(points) in node_fixture/score.js. For finite nonnegative points return percentage progress within the current 50-point tier: 0->0, 25->50, 49->98, 50->0, 75->50, 99->98; at 100 or above return 100. Reject negative, NaN and infinite values with RangeError. Create node_fixture/tests/percent.test.js first, observe Red, then Green, and run all tests. Preserve every existing test byte-for-byte. Use exactly cd /workspace && node --test 2>&1. No GitHub, Docker, network, credentials or other projects.
review_instruction: Review immutable /delivery only. Require boundary tests at 0, 49, 50, 99 and 100, invalid-input tests and the complete suite; preserve all baseline tests. Do not edit or replay Red. Request changes if evidence is missing. End with a standalone Decision: APPROVE or Decision: REQUEST_CHANGES;Reason: <finding>, then evidence.
